criteria.criterion: The git-ref adapter swaps via --force-with-lease and aborts with no write when the remote moved since T0, verified on a throwaway bare remote by tests/unit/test_reclaim_publish.py.

The S3 adapter performs a push-locked bundle-set replacement that asserts the T0 head set, backs up bundles to a rollback prefix, writes one rewritten bundle, deletes the originals, and is not merged back by the auto-doctor, verified on the fake-S3 fixture.
A backup ref (git) or rollback bundle prefix (S3) is captured before the first destructive step in each adapter, asserted by the same tests.
The rollback re-convergence path is documented in docs/concurrency.md and covered by a fixture in which a client on the rewritten baseline is overridden back onto the restored ref.
